breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the simply supported beam with free (non-zero) slopes at the supports. It explicitly states 'slopes are free' and correctly computes a non-zero slope at x=0 (θ₀ ≈ 0.003 rad), directly contradicting the flawed instruction to set end slopes to zero. This aligns with the ground truth prompt which makes no such erroneous constraint.
